lead: Won Menifee's Mapes Road resurfacing from Sherman Rd to Dawson Rd ($299,936), awarded Oct 7, 2026, including minor shoulder widening to rebuild the road edge.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 15, 2026 (Menifee City Council 5-0 vote on Oct 7). Mapes Rd is a few miles from the yard: ask about dumping the grindings and buying base for the shoulder widening. Same company that called for a 10,000-ton base quote at Leon Rd & Holland Rd, so mention both jobs. Phone is the main office number from business directories.

lead: Owner and developer of the Menifee Valley project (about 595 acres, 11 lots for industrial, commercial and residential use); on Oct 7, 2026 Menifee approved posting $20.9M performance and labor bonds for its public improvements.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 15, 2026 (Menifee City Council 5-0 vote on Oct 7). Bonds that size usually mean streets, storm drains and utilities are about to be built. Ask who is doing the grading and street work and when it starts, then call those contractors about base and dumping.

lead: Garbani Haven: 67-lot subdivision with private roads on 20 acres at the northwest corner of Garbani Rd and Evans Rd, Menifee; the city approved its public improvement agreement and bonds on Oct 7, 2026.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 15, 2026 (Menifee City Council 5-0 vote on Oct 7). Menifee's construction updates name Haven Cal Pacific as doing offsite utility work on Evans and Garbani Roads; ask the site who the grading and paving contractors are.
